objective: Build package-owned AUZiX roots through deterministic APK transactions and keep media writers package-agnostic.
rules: Do not compensate in one layer for a defect owned by another.
Activation owns generated compatibility, service, desktop and state surfaces.
Media writers may partition, mount, install boot assets and seal artifacts; they may not alter package-owned files.
A profile changes list size, not transaction logic.
Existence checks never substitute for representative execution gates.
Notes explain decisions but do not override machine-readable authority.
prohibited: package payload injection by media writers
independent container, HDD and ISO package loops
updating expected hashes merely to pass a gate
live target patching when an offline root can prove the result
